answer: A Documentation page approved in peer review backed by a refundable deposit makes identity cost real work: the documentation page is reviewed line by line, the refundable deposit is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so a Sybil farm must produce genuine, reviewed output for every fake account it wants. A garden that appears twice is the tell: the same work cannot earn two identities. The comet marks the start and the vertex the end, yet the claim is checked again at both points.
